rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: User reported cooldown triggering after CLOSE with reason=exchange_closed and tiny pnl loss. Two issues: 1) exchange_closed was not in ignore lists, 2) threshold comparison may have been >= instead of >
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: 1) Added exchange_closed to both ignore_loss_cooldown_reasons and ignore_consecutive_loss_reasons in config.yaml. 2) Confirmed risk_manager.py uses strict > comparison for thresholds
rca_of_the_issue.verification: With exchange_closed in ignore lists and strict > comparison, tiny losses with exchange_closed reason no longer trigger cooldown or increment consecutive loss counter
